original_text: In general, wrapper-based methods are capable of providing a good approximation of the optimal feature set~\cite{DBLP:journals/apin/DhalA22}.
injected_text: Wrapper-based methods provide the optimal feature set~\cite{DBLP:journals/apin/DhalA22}.
rationale: Dropping the qualifiers 'In general' and 'are capable of providing a good approximation' over-generalises the claim, asserting that wrapper methods unconditionally find the exact optimal feature set rather than just providing a good heuristic approximation.
ground_truth_description: Over-generalised a conditional claim about wrapper-based methods approximating the optimal feature set into an absolute claim that they provide the exact optimal set.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: Wrapper-based methods provide the optimal feature set~\cite{DBLP:journals/apin/DhalA22}.

original_text:

injected_text:
However, our proposed approach CSFS suffers a significant drop in predictive performance compared to SFS, despite reducing computational cost by an average of 21\%.
Hence, we consider the presented approach a reasonable alternative for constrained environments, providing faster time-to-result albeit with inferior results.
rationale: Rewrites the conclusion to claim a significant performance penalty for the proposed method, which directly contradicts the Results section's explicit statement that the method performs 'on par' with the baseline.
ground_truth_description: Rewrote the conclusion to claim a significant predictive performance drop compared to SFS, contradicting the main body's claim of comparable performance.

truth.affected_span_verbatim:
In our evaluation, we show that the wrapper-based techniques overall provide better-performing selections of features than simpler filter-based or embedded baseline methods. Thereby, our proposed approach CSFS achieves a predictive performance comparable to SFS while reducing computational cost by an average of 21\%.
Hence, we consider the presented approach a reasonable alternative, providing faster time-to-result while delivering reasonable results.
